charts.title: TOI-880 c: orbits around TOI-880
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-880's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-880 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Zhang et al. 2025 (2025AJ....170..175Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZHANG_ET_AL__2025): P 6.3872703 d

charts.title: TOI-880 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-880 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (33, 87) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 34077285, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
